  her past correction: [夹竹桃→这个花]有毒 — her note: it is confusing to have花 ; it looks like they refer to two different flowers, but actually the same. 吃一种叫夹竹桃的花的时候

  her past correction: [-还]有的有毒

items.explanation: ^ → 朵: 朵 normally collocates with a single flower; use 这朵黄色的花.
是毒 → 有毒: here the structure needs a verb phrase describing the flower. Use 有毒, not 是毒.
Use 有 after 在这儿 to show that the 灵芝药 is present there. This keeps the story information clear.
Use 了 after 写 because the writing is a completed action in this sequence.
写 must take the thing being written as its object. Use 关于植物的课文 for “a text about plants.”
